1.title: Why Local Sentiment Kills Data Center Projects | Hamlet CEO
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Hamlet CEO discusses using AI to transcribe city council meetings, extract community sentiment, and map opposition to data center projects; announces free API access for academics and journalists.

1.title: AI Models Will Tap the Whole Economy in 2 Years | Aidan Smith
1.author: MTS
1.hook: Aidan Smith (Flapping Airplanes) discusses raising $1B to build data-efficient AI models through custom GPU primitives and architecture redesign; covers limits of whole-brain emulation, compute overhang risk management, and commercialization strategy.

2.title: Stock Pickers Used Claude To Design Potential Antivenoms
2.author: MTS
2.hook: Stock research firm used Claude to generate 318K+ antivenom designs in 64 hours; 17 of 211 lab-tested designs bound to toxins, but efficacy unproven. Covers the speed delta between AI design and wet-lab validation (35 days vs. 64 hours), biosecurity gating, and cost ($85K for 250 samples).

1.title: Magic Patterns CEO Reviews Startup Websites
1.author: Y Combinator
1.hook: AI design tool CEO demos Magic Patterns and MagicOS canvas, then reviews startup websites to dissect what makes AI-generated design feel intentional vs "vibe coded"; covers design taste development and balancing speed with quality.
